LSE.hours: SETS order book: opening auction call 07:50-08:00, continuous trading 08:00-16:30, closing auction 16:30-16:35 (random end within 30 s), London time. The trading-day structure (opening auction, regular trading, closing auction, closing price crossing) is in MIT201 section 4.4; the times are in the Millennium Exchange Business Parameters document and on the exchange's trading-hours page. Yahoo's 1-minute grid for the four lines runs 08:00-16:29 with the closing-auction print stamped 16:30.
LSE.tick_size: MIT201 section 5.5: tick sizes are static or follow a dynamic schedule set per security in the instrument reference data ('For ETFs not subject to ESMA tick size regime and all ETPs, Quote Response minimum tick size is 0.0001'). The schedule itself is in the Business Parameters file, not in a document this pipeline could fetch, so the tick of each line is inferred from the price grid of its 1-minute prints (etfmm.reference.infer_tick): CSPX 0.01 USD, VUAA 0.02 USD, VUSA 0.0025 GBP (results/reference_facts.json gives the on-grid shares).
sources: London Stock Exchange, MIT201 - Guide to the Trading System, Issue 15.6, effective 29 April 2024, https://www.lseg.com/content/dam/lseg/en_us/documents/londonstockexchange-backup/mit201-guide-to-the-trading-system.pdf

London Stock Exchange trading hours page, https://www.londonstockexchange.com/trade/equity-trading/trading-hours (javascript page; times also in ShareScope, 'The Trader: Understanding SETS Auctions', 2025-11-28)

Xetra.hours: ETFs: pre-trading 07:00(book)/08:00 retail early trading, opening auction call 08:55, opening auction price 09:00, intraday auction call 13:00 with price 13:02, closing auction call 17:30, closing auction price 17:35, post-trading to 22:00; CET/CEST ('Trading Parameter Deutsche Boerse Xetra, MIC XETR, as of December 1st, 2025')
Xetra.tick_size: 'Equities, DRs, Subscription Rights and MiFID-ETFs with origin EU or Switzerland: tick size according to ESMA (liquidity band 1-6); ETPs (incl. Non-MiFID ETFs): Liquidity Band 6-10' (same document). The RTS 11 table gives, for liquidity band 6, 0.02 for 100 <= price < 200, 0.05 for 200-500 and 0.10 for 500-1000. SXR8's prints sit on a 0.02 EUR grid (100 % of 29,780 prints), which the pipeline uses.
sources: Deutsche Boerse Cash Market, Trading Parameters Xetra (as of 1 December 2025), https://cashmarket.deutsche-boerse.com/resource/blob/250890/43c50e657b0ff5fb58132fbf6e063517/data/trading-parameters-xetra.pdf
Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2017/588 (RTS 11) tick size table as reproduced by Wiener Boerse, https://www.wienerborse.at/en/trading/trading-information/tick-size/

CME.es: E-mini S&P 500: multiplier USD 50, tick 0.25 index points (USD 12.50), quarterly expiries on the third Friday; Yahoo's continuous ES=F switches contract during expiry week (detected per bar, see etfmm.fairvalue.contract_switch)
sources: CME Group E-mini S&P 500 contract specifications, https://www.cmegroup.com/markets/equities/sp/e-mini-sandp500.contractSpecs.html

assumptions.creation_fixed_fee_usd: 1500 per primary-market order (the custody/transaction charge both issuers say is available from the Investment Manager); sensitivity 500-5000 in results/bound.csv
assumptions.basket_half_spread_bp: 1.5 bp to buy or sell the S&P 500 basket (the variable part of a cash creation's Duties and Charges / Cash Creation Fee); sensitivity in results/bound.csv
assumptions.es_half_spread: half a tick (0.125 index points) per contract plus USD 1.40 all-in fee per contract
assumptions.fx_half_spread_bp: 0.5 bp on GBP/USD and EUR/USD spot for the sizes here
assumptions.settlement_mismatch_days: 1 day of financing at the overnight rate: the ETF settles T+2 on LSE and Xetra, the US basket T+1; sensitivity 0-2 days
assumptions.etf_venue_fee_bp: 0.3 bp of notional per ETF fill (exchange and clearing)
